name: Sease
why: Technical tailoring from the Loro Piana brothers — sailing and skiing kit engineered in bio-based fabric, sold from the Alps and the Italian coast.
origin: Franco and Giacomo Loro Piana, Milan, 2016 — sons of Pier Luigi, who sold the family mill to LVMH in 2013; the name contracts sea and ease.
opview: Franco Loro Piana frames it as a kit containing everything you need to live your passion — city clothes for men who need to escape the city.

onething.n: signature piece — Sunrise fabric, a bio-nylon reworking of Solaro; link best-guess, verify

notes.ski: Founded on two kits, sailing and skiing, so the mountain is half the brief rather than a seasonal excursion. The stores follow the Alpine circuit.
notes.boat: Sea is half the name. Technical sailing kit built to be used rather than resort wear that references it, which separates it from everything else at this end of the dial.
notes.ital: Milan, founded by two Loro Piana sons after the family mill was sold. Italian cloth pointed at sport rather than at tailoring, which is a genuinely new position for an Italian house.
notes.tech: serious technical outerwear, and all of it Loro Piana’s Storm System, confirmed against the trademark register. As technical as the houses above it and not its own, which is what separates a 4 from a 5

cities: Online in the US — no stores. Milan (Brera) · St Moritz, Verbier, Courchevel, Gstaad, Kitzbühel · Geneva, Forte dei Marmi · Dubai Mall

marks: LICENSED: WISH(R) and WOOLWISH(R) (Loro Piana wool marks)
